correctness.rationale: The N-step clipped recurrence is a contraction with factor at most r^N. At the two pulses, a=min(1,p+r^g b), b=min(1,p+r^(N-g) a), and g<=N-g forces a>=b. Three exhaustive saturation cases give exactly p0=(1-r^N)/(1+r^g), p1=1-r^(N-g) and the two nonzero maximum terms; check equality at thresholds. Since each positive candidate strictly decreases for consecutive permissible gaps, their max with zero decreases strictly wherever the later gap still overflows. Independent 2592 exact rational checks reconstruct fixed points and monotonicity. Arbitrary real values follow from the displayed inequalities, not sampling.
